name: speaking-coach
description: Speaking Coach — live voice-conversation practice with audio-grounded coaching. Foundation build: no live providers yet.

scripts.test:integration: npm run test:integration:service && npm run test:integration:web
scripts.test:integration:service: uv run --project services/voice python -m pytest tests/integration --ignore=tests/integration/assembled -v
scripts.test:assembled: uv run --project services/voice python -m pytest tests/integration/assembled -v --confcutdir=tests/integration/assembled && playwright test --config=tests/integration/assembled/playwright.config.ts
